text:
Maria R.: quick prototype drop: combined p95 sparkline + heatmap band + time range scrub + inline sampling control. figma: https://www.figma.com/file/xxxx/latency-observability-proto :eyes:
Jamal K.: Nice layout. Two quick calls out: the heatmap color ramp is too compressed at the high-density end. We lose distinction between 90th and 95th buckets. Recommend switching to a perceptually-uniform palette (viridis) and placing numeric anchors at quartiles.
Ash P.: +1 on the palette. Also the p95 line is pretty thin and blends into gridlines on the light theme. Can we increase stroke to 2.5px and try #003f9f, or add a faint halo (1px white) for contrast?
Kevin L.: Sampling default behavior is important. The current artboard defaults to 1/10 which will hide sporadic tail spikes. Suggest dashboard default 1/5; keep 1/10 for global overviews. Also add a small sample-rate chip by the time picker so users know what they're viewing.
Jamal K.: Sample-rate chip should include a tooltip: "Sampling: 1 in 5 requests — tail values are estimated." Put it adjacent to the time picker so it surfaces during range changes.
Maria R.: layout question: stacked vs side-by-side for p95 + heatmap. Side-by-side feels tight under 1200px. Stacked gives more vertical room for the p95 sparkline. Thoughts on responsive default?
Ash P.: Default to stacked for <=1280. For wide displays, allow a toggle ("Split / Stacked") so power users can compare side-by-side at large widths.
Jordana M.: Accessibility notes: ensure p95 stroke color meets contrast >= 4.5:1 vs background. Keyboard users must be able to focus the chart series; add `aria-label="P95 latency for selected route"` and ensure tooltip content is reachable with keyboard and screen readers.
DesignBot: automated a11y scan — `.p95-line` (#2f75ff on #f8fafc) fails contrast (3.8:1). Suggested fixes: use #003f9f or add a 2px outline.
Kevin L.: Tooltips should display sample size and indication when value is estimated. Example: "p95: 312ms (n=12, est)". That prevents misinterpretation when sampling is in effect.
Maria R.: copy tweak: when sampling control is visible, change "Time range" label to "Time range & sampling" to improve discoverability.
Jamal K.: UX micro: heatmap hover should show counts plus median/p95 for that bin. Current hover only shows count.
Ash P.: For small screens, collapse the vertical legend into a compact color bar with numeric anchors (min/median/max) beneath the heatmap. Saves vertical space without losing distribution cues.
Jordana M.: Keyboard flow: time scrubber needs `role=slider` and `aria-valuetext="Range: 1h to now"`. Ensure focus ring is visible and supports high-contrast mode.
Maria R.: action items Ill take: 1) try darker p95 + halo, 2) default sampling 1/5 for dashboard view, 3) add sample-rate chip next to time picker, 4) swap heatmap to viridis + ticks, 5) default stacked <=1280 with toggle, 6) add aria attrs + keyboard tooltips. Will post updated frames later today. :thumbsup:
Kevin L.: I can draft the chip copy: "Sampling: 1/5 (tail estimates)"  short and clear.
Maria R.: perfect, thanks!
